summary.status: Complete counting audit; integrated recovery design remains open

opening_load_audit.source_scope: NASA Cruz/Kandis/Witkowski2003 distinguishes inflation drag/apparent-mass effects from earlier snatch. Its large DGB coefficients are not transferred to this hobby canopy.
opening_load_audit.smooth_model_missing: Apparent air mass, canopy overinflation, cloth/line inertia, slack-line snatch, elastic harness and packed deployment are absent. No measured opening coefficient exists.
opening_load_audit.snatch_limitations: The specified relative speeds are fault sensitivities, not observed canopy/rocket separation speeds. Reduced-mass collision excludes continuing aerodynamic work and added air mass; it is not a total deployment-energy upper bound. A canopy held by air can approach the much larger full-vehicle kinetic-energy bound.

compliant_source_curve_candidate.product: Paskal6mm polyester-jacket natural-rubber shockcord; source curve sensitivity only, not selected rocket hardware.
compliant_source_curve_candidate.caveats: No qualified dynamic/rate/hot/aged curve, end efficiency or rocket deployment evidence. Source terminology/breaking entries are not adopted as a working load or minimum. A separate strength-rated backup and both terminations must be charged.

junction_geometry.status: Machined G11 rounded ring geometry only; load introduction, layup, bending, termination crowding and service motion are unqualified.

open_findings: The rounded junction is centered at station0.60 m, aft of electronics; line fan-out, packing and hands/tools are not checked by a clear rigid ring.
Actual aramid termination, HMPE pick lengths, all18 ends, bend contact and junction crowding remain unqualified.
Fixed-mode aft transfer exceeds the estimated combined plywood-rail axial screen in the severe timing probe; no free bypass branch is invented.
The complete changed-part motion report is required: neutral frame clearance alone does not close rods/cassette or coupled motion. Earlier inboard routing intersected the motor mount.
A Boolean one-solid frame does not prove continuous qualified laminate, the machining route, interlaminar strength or actual manufactured joints.
Upper body/coupler/nose/sled attachments are force assignments with unrated interfaces; positive-pin mass is still only a reserve.
HMPE heat exposure and the sealed bulkhead passages are not qualified by a paper wall or the existing3 g sleeve allowance.
Prospective lighter fins, battery, Package A rails and thermal reinforcement need one compatible resolved design and rerun static/flight/engineering evidence.
